bios.title: Biographies
bios.text: These versions may be quoted or adapted for editorial coverage.
bios.fullFirst: Denzel Rigaud founded EXPECTEDEND LLC and built MyBibleLens and The Water Check independently. He works as the company's full-stack developer, shaping each product from concept through design, engineering, and release.
bios.fullSecond: His work focuses on faith-centered software, digital well-being, and practical tools that help people use technology with intention. MyBibleLens is a sanctuary app for Christianity. The Water Check combines a private hydration estimate, practical water habits, and a community focused on daily consistency.
